title: Co-applicant tel-national pinned only at the pure-function level — no section-render assertion
evidence:
tel-national is asserted only as a pure-function return value in form_fields_test.gleam:
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[0][employer_ref_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[1][employer_ref_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[2][employer_ref_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[0][guarantor_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[1][guarantor_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
  form_fields.autocomplete_for("co_applicant[2][guarantor_phone]") |> should.equal("tel-national")
The sole rendered-HTML autocomplete assertion is guarantor_section_test.gleam:autocomplete_attributes_render_test (lines 117-130), which renders the GUARANTOR section and checks for autocomplete="name"/"tel"/"email"/"organization"/"transaction-amount" — it never asserts tel-national. `grep -rn 'tel-national' server/test/` matches ONLY form_fields_test.gleam; no test renders a co-applicant card and asserts autocomplete="tel-national" in serialized HTML. The co-applicant phone names are string-built in situation.gleam as prefix <> "[guarantor_phone]" and prefix <> "[employer_ref_phone]".
impact: Low (defense-in-depth gap, P3). The tel-national LOGIC is comprehensively pinned: bare phones map to tel, all three co-applicant card indices map both phone subtypes (employer_ref_phone and guarantor_phone) to tel-national, and the tel-vs-tel-national boundary is explicitly tested. view_text_field always stamps attribute("autocomplete", autocomplete_for(name)) and that generic render path is itself pinned (view_text_field_renders_the_token_test). A regression in autocomplete_for's return for these inputs would be caught. The untested surface is name-construction drift in situation.gleam (e.g. the prefix concatenation changing) or the co-applicant section ceasing to call view_text_field — both pre-existing and untouched by this diff. The novel/risky behavior (the disclosed lever against the Chromium per-type cap) gets a render pin for the simpler guarantor section but not for the co-applicant section where the bulk of the tel-national fields live.
recommended_fix: Add a render-level pin for one co-applicant card — render situation.view (or the co-applicant block) with co_applicant_count>=1 and assert the serialized HTML contains autocomplete="tel-national" — mirroring guarantor_section_test.gleam's autocomplete_attributes_render_test. Optional; not required for the fix to be correct.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 ~100%: autocomplete_for's full mapping is pinned by form_fields_test.gleam — every exact-name branch (first_name, last_name, email, phone, current_address, current_city, current_county, eircode, job_title, employer_name, guarantor_employer, monthly_income_cents, guarantor_monthly_income_cents, amount), every exercised suffix rule (_phone/_email/_name hit by the reference and guarantor trios; _monthly_income_cents/_employer are defensive and have no non-exact field to trigger them), the off fallback (desired_move_in_date, num_occupants, pet_details, reason_for_moving, employment_duration, eviction_details, additional_income[N][note], co_applicant[N][note]), bracket normalization (co_applicant[N][...] and additional_income[N][...] inner-field extraction), and the tel-national special case. Cross-checked against the source: every name passed to view_text_field across about_you/guarantor/references/situation/work_income is enumerated (current_living_situation and the other non-text fields are selects/checkboxes/radios and correctly carry no autocomplete). P1 ~90-95%: the tel-vs-tel-national boundary is pinned across all three card indices and both phone subtypes; the exact-wins-before-suffix NAME_VS_ORG priority (employer_name -> organization vs employer_ref_name -> name) is pinned both bare and bracketed, as is the co_applicant[0][employer_name] vs co_applicant[0][employer_ref_name] bracket-normalized form; the conditional show/hide regression is covered by the pre-existing guarantor_section_test suite (pristine_render, never_rented/student/unemployed/retired cohort renders, optional check/uncheck roundtrips, cohort-mirror agreement — all untouched by the diff) plus the diff's autocomplete render test which exercises the required-cohort open path. The single soft spot is the tel-national section-render pin (separate finding) — defense-in-depth only, since the mapping logic and the generic view_text_field render are both pinned. Overall ~90%+. Coverage is unit-level only, which is appropriate for this change class: a pure SSR attribute on an existing renderer (no new endpoint, no DB operation, no state transition); no integration/E2E pin on the /apply response for autocomplete is required.
recommended_fix: Gate is at the top tier (PASS); nothing blocks merge. To harden further: add the co-applicant tel-national section-render pin described in the separate finding.
